'''2016 Worlds Day 3 Jonny Chu LS We Have A Plan''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Jonny Chu]] at [[2016 World Championship]] (Day 3).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Jonny Chu]]
* '''Event:''' [[2016 World Championship]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[We Have A Plan / They Will Be Lost And Confused|We Have A Plan]]
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 3
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2016-world-championships/ PC list]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261013125623/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/2016-world-championships.html Internet Archive]
